name: The Ossuary Hall
description:
The stair ends in a long vault walled with bones. Skulls fill neat niches from floor to ceiling, thousands of them, each marked on the brow with a thumbprint of grey ash. The air is cold and smells of wet stone and old smoke.

At the far end of the hall, a door of green-black bronze fills an archway. Three sigils stand out from its surface: a sun, a crescent moon, and a grinning skull. Words are cut into the lintel above.
revisit: The ash-marked skulls watch you from their niches.

variants.text: The bronze door waits at the far end of the hall, its three sigils catching what little light there is.
The bronze door stands open, breathing cold air from the dark beyond.
You remember the order of the Ashen litany: the sun, then the moon, then the skull.

ambient: Water ticks somewhere in the dark.
A skull shifts in its niche with a dry click. Probably just settling.
Your breath smokes in the cold air.

exits.description: Worn steps climb toward grey light.
The open bronze door leads deeper into the barrow.
exits.blockedText: The bronze door will not move. Three sigils stare back at you: sun, moon, and skull.

features.name: bronze door
features.description: The door is a single casting of bronze, gone green-black with age. Three sigils rise from it at the height of your heart: a sun, a crescent moon, and a skull. Each looks as though it could be pressed. There are no handles and no keyholes.

interactions.label: Read the inscription
interactions.text:
The letters are deep and patient:

  FIRST THE LIGHT THAT WAKES THE FIELD,
  THEN THE LAMP THE NIGHT MUST WIELD,
  LAST THE FACE ALL FACES YIELD.

interactions.label: Study the inscription
interactions.text: You trace the carved letters and try to remember what you know of the Ashen Order's funeral rites.

success.text: It is the Ashen litany, recited at every burial: dawn, dusk, and death. The sun, then the moon, then the skull.

failure.text: The words blur together in the cold. A riddle, clearly, but its meaning slips away from you.

interactions.label: Press the sun sigil
interactions.text: The sun sigil sinks into the bronze with a deep, satisfied click.
The sun sigil clicks, then clicks again, wrongly.

onSuccess.text: A needle of black iron lances out of the bronze, and you snatch your hand back just in time.

onFail.text: A needle of black iron lances out of the bronze and bites deep into your palm.

effects.text: With a grinding sound, all three sigils slide back out to rest.

interactions.label: Press the moon sigil
interactions.text: The moon sigil slides inward. Somewhere inside the door, something heavy shifts.
The moon sigil clicks, then clicks again, wrongly.

onSuccess.text: A needle of black iron lances out of the bronze, and you snatch your hand back just in time.

onFail.text: A needle of black iron lances out of the bronze and bites deep into your palm.

effects.text: With a grinding sound, all three sigils slide back out to rest.

interactions.label: Press the skull sigil
interactions.text: The skull sigil sinks home. With a groan like a great beast waking, the bronze door swings inward on hidden hinges, and cold air rolls out of the dark beyond.
The skull sigil clicks, then clicks again, wrongly.

onSuccess.text: A needle of black iron lances out of the bronze, and you snatch your hand back just in time.

onFail.text: A needle of black iron lances out of the bronze and bites deep into your palm.

effects.text: With a grinding sound, all three sigils slide back out to rest.

features.name: bronze door
features.description: The bronze door stands open on hidden hinges. All three sigils are pressed flush with the metal, and the inscription above reads like a promise kept.

features.name: skull niches
features.description: Thousands of skulls, each marked on the brow with a thumbprint of grey ash. Here and there the living have left offerings in the niches: a ring, a dried flower, a child's wooden horse.

interactions.label: Search the skull niches
interactions.text: You run your hands along the cold niches, careful not to disturb the dead more than you must.

success.text: Behind a skull with a cracked jaw you find a handful of old silver coins, left as an offering for the ferryman. The dead won't miss them. Probably.

failure.text: Dust and bone. Nothing you would want to keep.
